correctness.rationale: Exact cover enumerates 840 distinct labelled systems, independently matched by the full 9! relabelling orbit. Triangular Boolean Walsh/monomial change of basis proves degree-rank equivalence. All G_d entries are exact binomial-overlap counts. For each d, an exact integer checker verifies the claimed spectral annihilating polynomial on a basis vector; relabelling transitivity extends to the entire matrix. Exact trace moments uniquely determine each multiplicity by Vandermonde, proving ranks 1,49,469,840 and the sharp cubic eigenvalue endpoints 63 and 4920. A separately programmed finite-field rank checker confirms all ranks at 10007. No infinite extrapolation is asserted.

value.rationale: The exact minimal degree needed to identify arbitrary measures on the full 840-state natural affine-design family is a genuine experimental-design and harmonic interpolation invariant. The 371-dimensional quadratic blind space is a meaningful quantitative obstruction, and the nine cubic positive eigenlevels give sharp stability of recovery in specified monomial coordinates. These are not supplied by the known 840 count or possible intersection sizes. The result is confined to order nine and does not rely on wider unproved claims.
